passages.provision_quote: for taxable years beginning from and after December 31 of the year in which notice is provided to the department pursuant to section 43-243, subsection B, paragraph 2, the tax is 2.5% of taxable income.
passages.note: Chapter 412 bill text; one clause (flat 2.5% income tax) matches S1 rung 4 language, but the enacted act is an omnibus of 32 unrelated tax sections (sales-tax exemptions, property tax, unemployment benefits, fire-district caps, school-tuition credits).
Bill overview names Mesnard as prime sponsor of the omnibus taxation bill, later signed by the governor.
Senate Third Reading roll call: Mesnard voted Yea on the omnibus taxation bill, 16-14.

rows.reasoning: Mesnard was prime sponsor and cast a Yea vote (16-14) on SB 1828 (2021), an omnibus taxation act bundling a phased flat income-tax rate ('the tax is 2.5% of taxable income') with unrelated sales-tax, property-tax, unemployment-benefit and fire-district provisions. Per V4.1, final passage of a multi-subject bill proves direction only, absent his own statement tying the vote to the income-tax-rate clause specifically, so no single rung (3 'targeted adjustments' vs. 4 'cut taxes broadly' vs. 5 'cut as far as possible and shrink government') can be established.
needs_source: Mesnard's own floor statement or explanation of vote tying his SB 1828 sponsorship/vote specifically to the §43-1011 flat-tax rate reduction, to distinguish S1 rung 3 from rung 4 from rung 5
